tests.name: an agent-prompt shows its notice, then sends its prompt as today
tests.why: agent-prompt with notice shown before the prompt is sent

tests.name: a mode in a result goes through AMC's mode switch; an unknown mode refuses a prompt and sends nothing
tests.why: mode plan applied via the mode switch; unknown mode refused

tests.name: maps each result kind the SDK declares
tests.why: adapter mapping of text and agent-prompt (notice, mode)

tests.name: text and completed results show a row; completed without a message reads Done
tests.why: completed with and without a message

tests.name: a completed result applies its mode, and says so when it cannot
tests.why: completed with mode; the cannot-apply half is not actually exercised

tests.name: a subcommand menu returns its options and writes nothing; picking one runs the parent with it
tests.why: menu options returned; pick invokes the command with the option

tests.name: a command's subcommand menu runs the pick, its other results land in AMC, and a kind AMC does not handle reads Not supported
tests.why: only test of the visible menu, one-option menu and Escape

tests.name: a timeline entry adds a row with its link and returns the prefill without sending it
tests.why: row with and without URL; prefill not sent

tests.name: prefillDraft > keeps a draft below the suggestion instead of replacing it
tests.why: prefill while a draft is in the composer keeps the draft

tests.name: prefillDraft > fills an empty message box with a command's suggestion
a model picker dialog asks the view to open AMC's picker; set-model goes through AMC's model switch with its warning
tests.why: model-picker dialog, set-model with warning, set-plan-model message

tests.name: runtimeSettingsChanged re-reads the session's settings
tests.why: title quotes the MUST's flag and re-read wording; only a completed result is flagged

tests.name: set-model during a turn applies at turn end, as AMC's own picker does
tests.why: model switch goes through the same deferred path as the picker

tests.name: an unhandled kind shows a quiet Not supported row naming the command and kind, and never done
tests.why: title quotes the MUST's row and naming wording; unknown, missing kind, broken field, other dialog

tests.name: never maps an unknown kind, a missing kind or a kind missing its required field to done
tests.why: adapter side; title quotes the MUST's missing-required-field case

tests.name: hands a slash command back as a prompt, so the host sends it and nothing goes out from the adapter
tests.why: existing unchanged Cursor (ACP) command test guards today's behaviour

findings.note: The re-read test flags only a completed result, so a flagged set-model that skips the re-read passes. A FAIL_TO_PASS test for a flagged set-model would fail on base and on this head, so it would expose the gap.

tests: tests/unit/command-result.test.ts::a completed result applies its mode, and says so when it cannot
tests/unit/command-result.test.ts::a mode in a result goes through AMC's mode switch; an unknown mode refuses a prompt and sends nothing
findings.note: The unknown mode is refused only for prompts, and the completed-with-mode test never tries a bad or refused mode. A completed-plus-unknown-mode FAIL_TO_PASS case would expose it; a mid-turn refusal needs an event-order test.

tests: tests/unit/command-result.test.ts::never maps an unknown kind, a missing kind or a kind missing its required field to done
findings.note: The malformed-field test covers some required fields but not the ones the adapter fills with defaults. More malformed fixtures as FAIL_TO_PASS tests would catch it, but only for the fields someone thinks to list.

tests: tests/unit/command-result.test.ts::maps each result kind the SDK declares
tests/unit/command-result.test.ts::a model picker dialog asks the view to open AMC's picker; set-model goes through AMC's model switch with its warning
findings.note: Found at a later head. Some picker, model and entry fields have no test, and a targeted picker is treated as a plain one. Per-field FAIL_TO_PASS tests would expose parts of this; the incomplete audit itself is not testable.

tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::a command's subcommand menu runs the pick, its other results land in AMC, and a kind AMC does not handle reads Not supported
tests/unit/command-result.test.ts::set-model during a turn applies at turn end, as AMC's own picker does
findings.note: The Escape check asserts only that the menu is hidden, not that nothing was invoked, and the Playwright test runs outside the gate. The invoke-then-Stop case comes from the brief's known cases, not from a numbered MUST. A base-failing test would not expose a weak assertion.

notes: No test cites a MUST by number; strict marks rest on title wording. MUST 3's Escape case and MUST 7's fake-ACP case have no new Vitest test: MUST 7 relies on an unchanged existing ACP test. Every command-result test imports a new module (src/host/engine/command-result.ts), so on base it fails at import, not on an assertion.
